On Saturday 13th July at Birmingham, Vaughan Thomas walked a fine race to win the 'Outer Circle 25 Miles' in 3 hours 25 mins. 43 secs. beating Don Thompson's course record by over a minute. Over a tough course Vaughan led from start to finish and was never troubled, crossing the line over 12 minutes ahead of A.
